### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

Read more

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

[Product Information][112]
[Watch Video][113]

[Product Finder][114]

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]
* [ [automotice]Automotive ][169]
* [ [Building]Building & Construction ][170]
* [ [Consumer]Consumer ][171]

* [ [Healthcare]Hygiene & Healthcare ][173]
* [ [Industrial]Industrial ][174]
* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct

challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

## One digital twin, clear operational insight

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]

demonstrating our commitment to social responsibility. This not only meets environmental goals but
also supports underrepresented communities.

Compliance and Ethical Production

We are dedicated to ethical production practices, ensuring our products meet stringent ESG
standards. Our solutions help clients meet governance and compliance requirements while contributing
to societal well-being.

### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

## Beijing Ultrasonic: Your Global Partner for Advanced Ultrasonic Engineering

Beijing Ultrasonic stands at the forefront of acoustic engineering, delivering high-performance
industrial ultrasonic cleaning equipment and core components to a global market. With over 15 years
of dedicated manufacturing expertise, we provide comprehensive solutions designed to tackle the most
demanding industrial challenges. Our state-of-the-art ultrasonic cleaners are engineered for
precision, utilizing advanced cavitation technology to ensure unparalleled cleaning efficiency. We
serve a diverse range of critical sectors, including automotive, aerospace, medical device
manufacturing, electronics, and precision optics, where microscopic cleanliness is non-negotiable.

Beyond complete cleaning systems, we are a leading global provider of core ultrasonic hardware. Our
extensive product portfolio includes high-Q piezoelectric ultrasonic transducers, robust digital
ultrasonic generators with automatic frequency tracking, and advanced ultrasonic mist makers for
industrial atomization. By leveraging rigorous quality control and innovative sweep frequency
technologies, our components guarantee 24/7 continuous, heavy-duty operation with maximum energy
transfer and minimal heat generation. Whether you require standard 28kHz or 40kHz piezoelectric
components, high-frequency megasonic sensors, or specialized ultrasonic humidification solutions,
our factory delivers unmatched reliability and acoustic stability.

Understanding that every industrial workflow requires specific technical parameters, Beijing
Ultrasonic specializes in highly flexible OEM and ODM manufacturing services. We offer full
customization across all product lines—from bespoke tank dimensions and multi-frequency power
supplies to specialized transducer arrays and private labeling. Our large-scale production facility
in China ensures rapid prototyping, rigorous testing, and fast global deployment. Serving
professional clients across more than 50 countries, we are committed to seamlessly integrating our
advanced industrial ultrasonic technologies into your supply chain, providing the
precision-engineered durability and technical innovation your business demands to stay competitive
in the global market.

### Ultrasonic Applications

#### Plastic & Rubber Welding

Achieve fast, reliable, and glue-free ultrasonic welding, riveting, and forming of complex
thermoplastic parts.

#### Automobile & Aerospace

Degreasing and cleaning of engine parts, fuel injectors, and aviation bearings; ultrasonic welding
of automotive plastic components.

#### Medical & Pharmaceutical

Thorough cleaning and sterilization of surgical instruments, dental tools; extraction of active
pharmaceutical ingredients.

#### Watch, Jewelry & Optics

Non-destructive, ultra-fine cleaning of precious jewelry, delicate watch movements, and optical
lenses without scratching.

#### Musical Instruments

Deep cleaning of brass and woodwind instruments to remove internal dirt and maintain optimal
acoustic performance and longevity.

#### Semiconductor & Electronics

Precision cleaning of PCBs, silicon wafers, microchips, and electronic components; ultrasonic wire
bonding.

#### Machining, Hardware & Surface Finishing

Deep removal of oil, grease, rust, and polishing paste from metal parts before electroplating or
coating.

#### Textile & Non-Woven Fabrics

Seamless ultrasonic sewing, cutting, and lace making for medical masks, protective clothing, and
packaging bags.

#### Food & Beverage Processing

Precise ultrasonic cutting for bakery, cheese, and frozen foods; defoaming and liquid homogenizing.

#### Chemical & Laboratory

Ultrasonic cell disruption, emulsification, dispersion of nanomaterials (like graphene), and
accelerating chemical reactions.

#### New Energy & Battery Manufacturing

High-speed ultrasonic welding of lithium battery tabs and copper/aluminum foils; dispersion of solar
cell coatings.

#### Non-Destructive Testing - NDT

Accurate ultrasonic flaw detection and thickness measurement for critical welds, pipelines, and
pressure vessels.

#### Environmental & Water Treatment

Ultrasonic degradation of difficult organic pollutants in wastewater, algae removal, and sludge
disintegration.

#### Metallurgy & Powder Materials

Ultrasonic degassing and grain refinement of metals; vibrating screens for ultra-fine powder
separation.

#### Petrochemical & Heavy Industry

Reducing heavy oil viscosity, preventing pipeline scaling, and accelerating crude demulsification
and dehydration.

## Beijing Ultrasonic: Your Global Partner for Advanced Ultrasonic Engineering

Beijing Ultrasonic stands at the forefront of acoustic engineering, delivering high-performance
industrial ultrasonic cleaning equipment and core components to a global market. With over 15 years
of dedicated manufacturing expertise, we provide comprehensive solutions designed to tackle the most
demanding industrial challenges. Our state-of-the-art ultrasonic cleaners are engineered for
precision, utilizing advanced cavitation technology to ensure unparalleled cleaning efficiency. We
serve a diverse range of critical sectors, including automotive, aerospace, medical device
manufacturing, electronics, and precision optics, where microscopic cleanliness is non-negotiable.

Beyond complete cleaning systems, we are a leading global provider of core ultrasonic hardware. Our
extensive product portfolio includes high-Q piezoelectric ultrasonic transducers, robust digital
ultrasonic generators with automatic frequency tracking, and advanced ultrasonic mist makers for
industrial atomization. By leveraging rigorous quality control and innovative sweep frequency
technologies, our components guarantee 24/7 continuous, heavy-duty operation with maximum energy
transfer and minimal heat generation. Whether you require standard 28kHz or 40kHz piezoelectric
components, high-frequency megasonic sensors, or specialized ultrasonic humidification solutions,
our factory delivers unmatched reliability and acoustic stability.

Understanding that every industrial workflow requires specific technical parameters, Beijing
Ultrasonic specializes in highly flexible OEM and ODM manufacturing services. We offer full
customization across all product lines—from bespoke tank dimensions and multi-frequency power
supplies to specialized transducer arrays and private labeling. Our large-scale production facility
in China ensures rapid prototyping, rigorous testing, and fast global deployment. Serving
professional clients across more than 50 countries, we are committed to seamlessly integrating our
advanced industrial ultrasonic technologies into your supply chain, providing the
precision-engineered durability and technical innovation your business demands to stay competitive
in the global market.

### Ultrasonic Applications

#### Plastic & Rubber Welding

Achieve fast, reliable, and glue-free ultrasonic welding, riveting, and forming of complex
thermoplastic parts.

#### Automobile & Aerospace

Degreasing and cleaning of engine parts, fuel injectors, and aviation bearings; ultrasonic welding
of automotive plastic components.

#### Medical & Pharmaceutical

Thorough cleaning and sterilization of surgical instruments, dental tools; extraction of active
pharmaceutical ingredients.

#### Watch, Jewelry & Optics

Non-destructive, ultra-fine cleaning of precious jewelry, delicate watch movements, and optical
lenses without scratching.

#### Musical Instruments

Deep cleaning of brass and woodwind instruments to remove internal dirt and maintain optimal
acoustic performance and longevity.

#### Semiconductor & Electronics

Precision cleaning of PCBs, silicon wafers, microchips, and electronic components; ultrasonic wire
bonding.

#### Machining, Hardware & Surface Finishing

Deep removal of oil, grease, rust, and polishing paste from metal parts before electroplating or
coating.

#### Textile & Non-Woven Fabrics

Seamless ultrasonic sewing, cutting, and lace making for medical masks, protective clothing, and
packaging bags.

#### Food & Beverage Processing

Precise ultrasonic cutting for bakery, cheese, and frozen foods; defoaming and liquid homogenizing.

#### Chemical & Laboratory

Ultrasonic cell disruption, emulsification, dispersion of nanomaterials (like graphene), and
accelerating chemical reactions.

#### New Energy & Battery Manufacturing

High-speed ultrasonic welding of lithium battery tabs and copper/aluminum foils; dispersion of solar
cell coatings.

#### Non-Destructive Testing - NDT

Accurate ultrasonic flaw detection and thickness measurement for critical welds, pipelines, and
pressure vessels.

#### Environmental & Water Treatment

Ultrasonic degradation of difficult organic pollutants in wastewater, algae removal, and sludge
disintegration.

#### Metallurgy & Powder Materials

Ultrasonic degassing and grain refinement of metals; vibrating screens for ultra-fine powder
separation.

#### Petrochemical & Heavy Industry

Reducing heavy oil viscosity, preventing pipeline scaling, and accelerating crude demulsification
and dehydration.

## The Chainlink Platform: unlock onchain finance at scale

Chainlink is the only all-in-one oracle platform for creating advanced blockchain applications that
interoperate across blockchains and existing systems while embedding critical data, compliance, and
privacy capabilities.

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions and DeFi protocols have also adopted
Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity
International, UBS, ANZ, Aave, GMX, Lido, and many others.

## Why Chainlink is the global standard

### Solving the core challenges of onchain finance

Chainlink delivers critical infrastructure for data, identity, compliance, connectivity, and
orchestration, enabling institutions, DeFi protocols, and onchain applications to build, operate,
and scale a wide range of financial products and services.

### Trusted by leading financial institutions and DeFi protocols

Working alongside global institutions like Swift, J.P. Morgan, and Mastercard and leading DeFi
protocols like Aave and GMX, Chainlink provides the infrastructure to enable secure, scalable, and
interoperable financial applications.

### Built for security, reliability, and scale

Chainlink infrastructure has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value, backed by a proven
track record of uptime, accuracy, and resilience across leading blockchain networks.

interoperate across blockchains and existing systems while embedding critical data, compliance, and

International, UBS, ANZ, Aave, GMX, Lido, and many others.

## Why Chainlink is the global standard

### Solving the core challenges of onchain finance

Chainlink delivers critical infrastructure for data, identity, compliance, connectivity, and
orchestration, enabling institutions, DeFi protocols, and onchain applications to build, operate,
and scale a wide range of financial products and services.

### Trusted by leading financial institutions and DeFi protocols

Working alongside global institutions like Swift, J.P. Morgan, and Mastercard and leading DeFi
protocols like Aave and GMX, Chainlink provides the infrastructure to enable secure, scalable, and
interoperable financial applications.

### Built for security, reliability, and scale

Chainlink infrastructure has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value, backed by a proven
track record of uptime, accuracy, and resilience across leading blockchain networks.

## Cooler Master ESG

In response to the Paris Agreement, Cooler Master has established group-level greenhouse gas (GHG)
reduction targets, decarbonization pathways, and transition strategies. Our science-based targets
were officially validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). Through continuous
decarbonization efforts, we have achieved meaningful progress: in 2024, our absolute GHG emissions
were approximately 59% lower than the 2022 base year, demonstrating steady advancement along our
science-based reduction pathway.

## Cooler Master ESG

In response to the Paris Agreement, Cooler Master has established group-level greenhouse gas (GHG)
reduction targets, decarbonization pathways, and transition strategies. Our science-based targets
were officially validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). Through continuous
decarbonization efforts, we have achieved meaningful progress: in 2024, our absolute GHG emissions
were approximately 59% lower than the 2022 base year, demonstrating steady advancement along our
science-based reduction pathway.

One-click exports tuned for the engine you actually use.

05 / Anywhere

### Runs in your *browser.*

Chromebook, MacBook Air, gaming rig — same experience. WebGPU under the hood.

i.

### Describe.

Plain English. Or drop a reference photo. Or pick a starting point from the library.

ii.

### Refine.

Adjust tiling, roughness, normal strength. Preview live on sphere, cube, or cloth.

iii.

### Export.

Choose your engine. Get a folder of maps. Drop it in. Done.

— Community

Every published material is free, remixable, and credited. Built by artists, for artists.

## Know what's happening in real time

Distill continuously monitors news coverage, press releases, company blogs, and LinkedIn posts — so
you don't have to check dozens of sources manually.

## Only see the updates worth your attention

Distill filters out duplicate coverage, low-signal updates, and irrelevant noise, helping you
quickly spot the developments that actually matter.

[OpenAI icon]

OpenAI releases new AI model

Reasoning and multimodality improved

[Stripe icon]

Stripe closes Bridge acquisition

## Get alerts where your team already works

Receive instant alerts in Slack or Microsoft Teams, read weekly email briefings, or browse
everything in Distill's live feed.

Start tracking your market today

Set up your watchlist in minutes. Start monitoring the companies that matter to you.

[Start for free ][6]

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you
  don't read the same headline 20 times.
* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

## Know what's happening in real time

Distill continuously monitors news coverage, press releases, company blogs, and LinkedIn posts — so
you don't have to check dozens of sources manually.

## Only see the updates worth your attention

Distill filters out duplicate coverage, low-signal updates, and irrelevant noise, helping you
quickly spot the developments that actually matter.

## Get alerts where your team already works

Receive instant alerts in Slack or Microsoft Teams, read weekly email briefings, or browse
everything in Distill's live feed.

Start tracking your market today

Set up your watchlist in minutes. Start monitoring the companies that matter to you.

[Start for free ][6]

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you
  don't read the same headline 20 times.
* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

now uses every day in practice.

[Read the interview][77]

## Why experts trust our digital dentistry solutions
* #### Faster workflows, improved proficiency
  
  Save time by working with high-performance software that runs robustly, even when dealing with
  large and complex cases. Quick response times and optimal usability help speed up your daily work.
* #### It’s easy to use and to reach your high expectations
  
  Your complex procedures can become more simple and efficient, thanks to our experience working
  closely with dental professionals like yourself, creating more accessible dental software for the
  digital age.
* #### Flexibility as you require it
  
  Experience maximum flexibility and freedom through exocad’s modular and open approach. It’s not
  just the software that is flexible, the business model is too. Mix and match modules, buy
  perpetual CAD software licenses, or rent the software at attractive rates – it’s all your choice.
* #### Reliability you can trust
  
  You can rely on us to create software that you will continue to appreciate and profit from. Our
  product has proven its stability time and time again, because we always pay the greatest attention
  to quality and to detail. Our reliable updates provide new possibilities that are always driven by
  your needs.
* #### Independent & innovative
  
  Our software puts you at the forefront of innovation. Since our foundation in 2010, our dedicated
  team of engineers and researchers has consistently developed state-of-the-art innovations for the
  dental industry. As the independent and hardware-neutral technology provider, our goal is to push
  the limits of digital dentistry through software solutions.
* #### Truly future-proof
  
  We’re the dental CAD/CAM software provider with the widest choice of integrated solutions using
  third-party scanners, mills, printers, and materials. And we are always open to new ideas, ready
  to support today’s and tomorrow’s best solutions to meet and exceed our customers’ requirements.

# H&M Offers Material Analysis Expertise and Services

## Welcome to H&M Analytical Services, Inc

Founded in 1997, H&M Analytical Services is a full-service X-ray diffraction and analysis testing
lab which also provides a wide range of other testing and material characterization services.  Its
professional staff has years of material science experience in X-Ray diffraction techniques,
chemical analysis, particle size analysis, high resolution imaging and thermal analysis.  H&M is
here to meet all of your analytical testing needs for reverse engineering, competitive analysis, R&D
work, failure analysis and quality control testing.

H&M also provides materials science consultation as part of our service to the customer.  Our highly
trained staff of PhD’s are here to assist in technical issues that arise in your process and provide
solutions to suit your application.  We have provided analyses for many different fields including
materials science, pharmaceuticals, corrosion, geology, metallurgy, mining & life sciences to name a
few.  H&M also provides expert witness and litigation support services. We specialize in materials
characterization and failure analysis that can help in patent filings, patent and intellectual
property disputes and product liability, as well as forensic analysis. As one of the best litigation
support service companies, we have worked with both defendant and plaintiff attorneys.

For whatever your company’s requirements, H&M Analytical Services is here to help by utilizing state
of the art equipment as well as our combined experience to solve your most challenging problems. 
Our lab is cGMP compliant and FDA registered/inspected providing another quality check for your
pharmaceutical and other products.  H&M provides detailed reports on customer samples and provides
correct analysis promptly without effecting quality.

lab which also provides a wide range of other testing and material characterization services.  Its
professional staff has years of material science experience in X-Ray diffraction techniques,
chemical analysis, particle size analysis, high resolution imaging and thermal analysis.  H&M is
here to meet all of your analytical testing needs for reverse engineering, competitive analysis, R&D
work, failure analysis and quality control testing.

H&M also provides materials science consultation as part of our service to the customer.  Our highly
trained staff of PhD’s are here to assist in technical issues that arise in your process and provide
solutions to suit your application.  We have provided analyses for many different fields including
materials science, pharmaceuticals, corrosion, geology, metallurgy, mining & life sciences to name a
few.  H&M also provides expert witness and litigation support services. We specialize in materials
characterization and failure analysis that can help in patent filings, patent and intellectual
property disputes and product liability, as well as forensic analysis. As one of the best litigation
support service companies, we have worked with both defendant and plaintiff attorneys.

For whatever your company’s requirements, H&M Analytical Services is here to help by utilizing state
of the art equipment as well as our combined experience to solve your most challenging problems. 
Our lab is cGMP compliant and FDA registered/inspected providing another quality check for your
pharmaceutical and other products.  H&M provides detailed reports on customer samples and provides
correct analysis promptly without effecting quality.

# **Company Headquarters**

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing
accurate, up-to-date headquarters information for tens of thousands of leading companies across the
United States and around the world. Our platform is designed to serve as a trusted resource for
users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

We provide this headquarters information completely free of charge, making it easy to access
essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

Behind the scenes, our dedicated team works around the clock to collect, organize, and validate
headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed
process of sorting, data cleaning, and verification before it is published on our website. This
process ensures that outdated, incomplete, or misleading information is minimized, and that users
can rely on our directory with confidence.

Company Headquarters is committed to maintaining one of the most reliable and user-friendly
headquarters information directories available online. By continuously monitoring data updates and
verifying corporate details, we make sure the best and most accurate headquarters information is
accessible to users at all times, helping them quickly find the corporate contact and location
details they need, all in one convenient place.

Browse through our carefully selected headquarters listings to quickly locate the company
headquarters you are searching for, whether the organization operates locally, nationally, or
internationally. Our structured headquarters lists are organized for easy navigation, allowing users
to explore companies by name, category, or relevance and efficiently access accurate corporate
headquarters information in just a few clicks.

For a faster and more direct experience, you can also use the headquarters search box to search
across our complete headquarters directory. This powerful search feature enables you to instantly
find detailed company headquarters information, including corporate phone numbers, official
addresses, office locations, websites, and additional verified data, all from one centralized
platform.

## Heidelberg Materials North America

Lehigh Hanson is now Heidelberg Materials. In North America, Heidelberg Materials is a leading
supplier of cement, aggregates, ready mixed concrete, and asphalt with more than 450 locations and
approximately 9,000 employees.

## Material To Build Our Future

We're dedicated to our goal to create sustainable value with industry-leading products and solutions
to satisfy the construction needs of our customers around the world. See how we are Building a
Better Future for our people, our customers, our communities and our shareholders.

 

[[sustainable solutions]][52]

### Sustainability

Heidelberg Materials is committed to leading the development of sustainable solutions for built
environments.

[[Site contact holding phone]][54]

construction.

[**Customer Technology**][55]

Whatever building material you’re looking for, Heidelberg Materials is your trusted North American
supplier.

[**Material To Build Our Future**][57]

## 7^{th} International Conference on Electrical Engineering (ICSHM 2022 )

October 07 ~ 08, 2023, Virtual Conference

##### Program Committee

[More Details...][12]


##### Accepted Papers

[More Details...][13]


##### Virtual Conference





#### Scope [Call for Participation][14] [Program Schedule][15]

**7^{th} International Conference on Electrical Engineering (ICSHM 2022 ) **aims to bring together
researchers and practitioners from academia and industry to focus on recent systems and techniques
in the broad field of Electrical Engineering. Original research papers, state-of-the-art reviews are
invited for publication in all areas of Electrical Engineering.


Registered authors are now able to present their work through our online platforms

### Call for Papers


**7^{th} International Conference on Electrical Engineering (ICSHM 2022 ) **aims to bring together
researchers and practitioners from academia and industry to focus on recent systems and techniques
in the broad field of Electrical Engineering. Original research papers, state-of-the-art reviews are
invited for publication in all areas of Electrical Engineering.

Authors are solicited to contribute to the conference by submitting articles that illustrate
research results, projects, surveying works and industrial experiences that describe significant
advances in the following areas, but are not limited to:

##### Topics of interest include, but are not limited to, the following
* Communication
* Control and Robotics
* Electromagnetic and Photonics
* High Voltage Engineering
* Image Processing and Multimedia, Biomedical Imaging
* LSI
* Measurements and Instrumentation
* Nano Devices and Integrated Systems
* Power Electronics
* Power Systems
* Systems Science and Signal Processing

#### Paper Submission

Authors are invited to submit papers through the conference [Submission System][16] by **Closed**.
Submissions must be original and should not have been published previously or be under consideration
for publication while being evaluated for this conference. The proceedings of the conference will be
published by [Electrical and Electronics Engineering: An International Journal (ELELIJ)][17]
(Confirmed).

Selected papers from ** ICSHM 2022 **, after further revisions, will be published in the special
issue of the following journal.
* [Electrical & Computer Engineering: An International Journal (ECIJ)][18]
* [Electrical Engineering: An International Journal (EEIJ)][19]
* [Circuits and Systems: An International Journal (CSIJ)][20]

##### Important Dates

###### Submission Deadline

**Closed**

###### Authors Notification

**October 04, 2023**

###### Registration & camera - Ready Paper Due

**October 05, 2023**

#### Proceedings

The soft copy of the proceedings will be available on Journal web pages.

The Registration fee is 250 USD for accepted article Authors. Atleast one author of accepted paper
is required to register at the full registration rate.

researchers and practitioners from academia and industry to focus on recent systems and techniques
in the broad field of Electrical Engineering. Original research papers, state-of-the-art reviews are
invited for publication in all areas of Electrical Engineering.

Authors are solicited to contribute to the conference by submitting articles that illustrate
research results, projects, surveying works and industrial experiences that describe significant
advances in the following areas, but are not limited to:

##### Topics of interest include, but are not limited to, the following
* Communication
* Control and Robotics
* Electromagnetic and Photonics
* High Voltage Engineering
* Image Processing and Multimedia, Biomedical Imaging
* LSI
* Measurements and Instrumentation
* Nano Devices and Integrated Systems
* Power Electronics
* Power Systems
* Systems Science and Signal Processing

#### Paper Submission

Authors are invited to submit papers through the conference [Submission System][16] by **Closed**.
Submissions must be original and should not have been published previously or be under consideration
for publication while being evaluated for this conference. The proceedings of the conference will be
published by [Electrical and Electronics Engineering: An International Journal (ELELIJ)][17]
(Confirmed).

Selected papers from ** ICSHM 2022 **, after further revisions, will be published in the special
issue of the following journal.
* [Electrical & Computer Engineering: An International Journal (ECIJ)][18]
* [Electrical Engineering: An International Journal (EEIJ)][19]

# Empowering *innovation* everywhere

We connect people and ideas that transform groundbreaking research and technology into tangible
solutions. Together, we make it real.

[**AdMaCom 2026**][56] is now open for applications! If you are TRL4-6, into materials and keen to
move ahead, go directly to the application!

If you would like to explore more to see where you fit in:

[ Find your path ][57]

### A community that turns emerging technology into reality

Since 2016, INAM (Innovation Network for Advanced Materials) has connected startups, corporations,
researchers and investors to accelerate the market entry of new material innovations across
industries.

#### 
#### Startup programs

Whether it’s refining your technology or scaling your startup globally, we provide mentorship and
access to an international network to transition scientific research out of the lab to real-world
applications.

[See all programs][58]

[Startup Programs]

#### 
#### Technology scouting

Whether it’s Open Innovation Challenges or scouting, we connect corporate clients with cutting-edge
startups to solve your specific, technological challenges. We lead you to high-impact
collaborations.

Explore innovation opportunities

[Deep Tech Events]

#### 
#### Deep tech events

Our events bring together investors, startups, and industry, to uncover breakthroughs and build
strategic partnerships. Whether through workshops or demo days, our events open doors to new
opportunities.

[ Join events][59]

[Tackle Complex Challenges]

# Empowering *innovation* everywhere

We connect people and ideas that transform groundbreaking research and technology into tangible
solutions. Together, we make it real.

[**AdMaCom 2026**][56] is now open for applications! If you are TRL4-6, into materials and keen to
move ahead, go directly to the application!

If you would like to explore more to see where you fit in:

[ Find your path ][57]

### A community that turns emerging technology into reality

Since 2016, INAM (Innovation Network for Advanced Materials) has connected startups, corporations,
researchers and investors to accelerate the market entry of new material innovations across
industries.

#### 
#### Startup programs

Whether it’s refining your technology or scaling your startup globally, we provide mentorship and
access to an international network to transition scientific research out of the lab to real-world
applications.

[See all programs][58]

[Startup Programs]

#### 
#### Technology scouting

Whether it’s Open Innovation Challenges or scouting, we connect corporate clients with cutting-edge
startups to solve your specific, technological challenges. We lead you to high-impact
collaborations.

Explore innovation opportunities

[Deep Tech Events]

#### 
#### Deep tech events

Our events bring together investors, startups, and industry, to uncover breakthroughs and build
strategic partnerships. Whether through workshops or demo days, our events open doors to new
opportunities.

[ Join events][59]

[Tackle Complex Challenges]

Upcoming Events
* ## Members' Meeting
  
  22 July 2026 17:00-18:00
  
  Join us online to discuss cutting-edge issues in advanced materials. Topic: Smart and responsive
  materials
  
  [RSVP][60]
* ## AdMaCom Info Session
  
  5 August 2026 12:00-13:00
  
  Do you have questions about what the AdMaCom is all about? Then join us for this informal session
  to find out more!
  
  [RSVP][61]
* ## AdMaCom Demo Day
  
  15 October 2026 15:00-21:00
  
  Join us for a afternoon of exploring advances in materials science and meet top startups from
  around the world.
  
  [RSVP][62]

Join *200+* network partners who have made an impact
* [Margaret Kocherga, Light & Charge Solutions]
  
  ## "There were so many lessons. The biggest help that I got was the mentors working with me to
  ## identify what my value propositions are."
  
  Margaret Kocherga, Light & Charge Solutions
* [A young man with curly blond hair and glasses giving a presentation or speech against a blue
  pixelated background.]
  
  ## "It was a very intense time but it gave us space to completely evaluate every aspect of our
  ## business and will be invaluable to us going forward.”
  
  Sam Cryer, Thermulon
* [A young man with short brown hair wearing a light blue button-up shirt, speaking or presenting
  against a dark blue background with pixelated pattern.]
  
  ## "Advanced Materials Competition is an excellent single-focus experience program that achieves
  ## what it set out to achieve -- meaningful conversations with the right people."
  
  Graham Bell, Next Aero

### Driving innovation and impact through global collaboration

INAM is recognized by the Financial Times as one of Europe’s leading startup ecosystems for two
years running. If you're looking for access to opportunities and a network that drives innovation,
become a member of INAM.

[Learn more][63]

### Meet INAM’s members

Connect with hundreds of industry, startup and research members that have chosen INAM to level up
their deep tech businesses.

### About US

PT INTI (Persero), one of the state-owned enterprises in strategic industries, was officially
established on December 30, 1974. The Company headquartered in Jalan Moch Toha No. 77 Bandung has
portfolio in the fields of Manufacture, System Integrator, and Digital. To support its business, PT
INTI (Persero) also operates an eight hectares production facility on Jalan Moch Toha No 225 which
produces telecommunications and electronic devices.

### Unggul Priyanto

**President Commissioner**

Dr. Ir. Unggul Priyanto, M.Sc. officially appointed as Commissioner of PT INTI (Persero) since March
22, 2016. The man who born in Malang, 30 September 1958 is a graduate of Chemical Engineering at the
Institut Teknologi Bandung in 1985.

### Trisno Hendradi

**Commissioner**

TNI Intermediate Marshal (Ret.) Trisno Hendradi is a retired high-ranking TNI Air Force officer who
last served as Commander of the Staff School and Indonesian National Army Command (TNI) in
2019-2020.

### Rahmadi Murwanto

**Commissioner**

Rahmadi Murwanto, Ak., M.Acc., Ph.D. began his career at the Ministry of Finance in 1991 at the
Financial Education and Training Agency (BPLK) after graduating Diploma-III from the State College
of Accountancy (STAN).

### Yanuar Rokhmad Madyantoro

**Commissioner**

Yanuar Rokhmad Madyantoro, B.Sc., M.M., has a track record of experience in restructuring and
revitalization that he gained from strategic positions in a number of companies, including PT
Perusahaan Pengelola Asset (Persero).

# "Ironspring Ventures stood out to us because of their deep commitment to industrials and the
# strength of the community they’ve built around it. Their unmatched network represents some of the
# most influential operators and enterprises in our space. That connectivity creates real strategic
# advantage - not just introductions, but informed partnership. Ironspring understands that
# industrial businesses aren’t just adopting software; they’re rebuilding their operating systems."

[- Charles Soll]
- Charles SollCo-Founder & CEO @ Moab


# "We decided to partner with Ironspring Ventures because of the strong alignment we felt during our
# conversations with Ty and the broader team. From the beginning, we appreciated the thoughtful
# questions, deep understanding of the construction industry, and genuine excitement for what we’re
# building. The relationship felt like a true partnership, and those early conversations gave us
# confidence that Ironspring would be a supportive and strategic long-term ally in our mission to
# transform construction."

[- NK Chaitanya]
- NK ChaitanyaCo-Founder & CEO @ Track3D


# "The Ironspring team has pushed us to define our core principles and values, and these have became
# our north star. Now, for every tough call, we come back to these principles. What sets Ironspring
# apart is that they’re in the arena with us leveraging their domain expertise, not just watching
# from the sidelines."

[- Pablo Fernandez]
- Pablo FernandezCo-Founder & CEO @ Big Rentals


# "We chose to partner with Ironspring Ventures because they truly understand what we’re trying to
# build. Their deep industrial expertise, associated network, and hands-on strategic support make
# them feel like an extension of our team. It’s not just about the capital—it’s about shared vision
# and values. Together, we’re tackling real challenges such as labor shortages and driving
# automation forward in ways that are both practical and transformative for manufacturers and supply
# chain operators across the Americas."

[- Juan Aparicio]
- Juan AparicioCo-Founder & CEO @ Reshape Automation


# “What impressed me most in the beginning was the strong sector alignment and courage to have a
# point-of-view rather than going after the VC flavor of the month. As we got to know each other
# better, I also found an alignment of culture and values, prioritizing the ‘get it done’ over
# fanciness and willingness to help, demonstrated by a plethora of introductions already.”

[- Carl-Christoph “CCR” Reckers]
- Carl-Christoph “CCR” ReckersCEO @ FleetPulse


# “Ironspring Ventures and Mango are cut from the same cloth: both are purpose-built to modernize
# legacy industrial sectors through cutting edge technology and an unshakeable bias toward doing the
# right thing for the long term. That shared DNA of values first, trust as currency, and focus on
# results made partnering an easy choice - with Ironspring, we gain investors who think like
# operators, value relationships like builders, and help us achieve the high expectations we set for
# Mango.”

[- Sergio Angelini]
- Sergio AngeliniCo-Founder & CEO @ Mango


# “Ironspring has a unique understanding of our end markets and the value that tech can unlock in
# these traditional, conservative spaces. Ty's background and approach is deeply appreciated as is
# his ability to add value in each interaction.”

[- Rahil Siddiqui]
- Rahil SiddiquiCo-Founder & CEO @ Wilya


# “We are very happy with our choice to partner with Ironspring Ventures. The team truly gets
# industrials and energy. Their network is top notch and they've been super helpful so far. We're
# excited to continue working together and building the business.”

[- Justin Lopas]

Family-run and globally driven, the Knauf Group is a trusted building materials leader that

assurance.

employees worldwide.

# The open source procedural materials authoring tool

## Create PBR materials using graphs where nodes create and transform textures. Export materials for
## use in game engines and movie assets.

[ Get on itch.io][10]   [ Get on Steam][11]

### Features

### Node Based

With over 200 nodes available, new nodes can be created either by connecting and grouping existing
nodes, or by describing them in GLSL.

### PBR Materials

Effortlessly craft and export PBR materials compatible with the Godot, Unity and Unreal game
engines, streamlining the game development process.

### Community Library

Use the vast library of hundreds of materials, nodes, brushes and environments made by our
community, for use in your projects or for studying how nodes work.

### Texture Painting Tool

Texture 3D models with procedural brushes using the experimental painting tool.

### Getting Started

### Material Maker on the web

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about getting started with NotebookLM.

What is Notebook LM?

Notebook LM is Google's AI-powered research assistant designed to help you understand complex
documents faster. Simply upload PDFs, articles, YouTube videos, or audio files, and the AI analyzes
your content to provide summaries, answer questions, and generate study materials. Whether you're a
student preparing for exams, a researcher analyzing papers, or a professional reviewing reports,
Notebook LM transforms hours of reading into minutes of actionable insights.

How do I chat with PDFs?

Upload your PDF to Notebook LM and start asking questions in plain English—it's that simple. The AI
reads your entire document and responds with accurate answers, complete with citations pointing to
the exact source location. You can ask for summaries, request explanations of complex topics, or
compare information across multiple uploaded documents. This conversational approach makes research
more intuitive than traditional keyword searches.

Can it generate podcasts?

Yes, Notebook LM's Audio Overview feature creates podcast-style discussions from your documents with
one click. Two AI hosts engage in a natural conversation about your content, covering key points and
insights in an easy-to-follow format. These 10-15 minute audio summaries are perfect for learning
while commuting, exercising, or multitasking. It's like having experts explain your research
materials in an engaging, accessible way.

How does the quiz generator work?

The quiz generator automatically creates practice questions based on your uploaded content. It
analyzes key concepts, facts, and themes to generate multiple-choice, true/false, and short-answer
questions tailored to your materials. Each question includes citations so you can verify answers and
deepen your understanding. This feature is ideal for exam preparation, knowledge retention, and
self-assessment without manually creating study questions.

What is the flashcard feature?

Notebook LM's flashcard generator extracts important terms, definitions, and concepts from your
documents to create digital study cards automatically. These flashcards use proven learning
techniques to help you memorize and retain information effectively. You can review them directly in
the app or export them for offline study. Students and professionals use this feature to master new
topics quickly without spending hours creating flashcards manually.

Is my data secure?

Your privacy and data security are top priorities for Notebook LM. All uploaded documents are
encrypted using industry-standard protocols, both during transfer and storage. Importantly, your
content is never used to train AI models, keeping your information completely private. You maintain
full control over your notebooks and can permanently delete your data anytime. The platform meets
enterprise-grade security standards suitable for sensitive academic and business documents.

What file formats are supported?

Notebook LM accepts a wide range of formats to fit your research workflow. You can upload PDFs,
Google Docs, Google Slides, text files, Markdown documents, and audio recordings. The platform also
lets you import web pages by pasting URLs and analyze YouTube videos through their transcripts. This
flexibility means you can consolidate research from books, articles, lectures, and online content
all in one place.

Is Notebook LM free to use?

Notebook LM offers a free tier with generous features to get you started immediately. The free plan
includes notebook creation, document uploads, AI chat, and study material generation. Premium plans
are available for users who need higher upload limits, longer audio overviews, and advanced
collaboration tools. Whether you're a casual learner or a power researcher, there's a plan that fits
your needs and budget.

# Global leader in surface technologies & advanced materials

At Oerlikon, we engineer innovative technologies and solutions that make our customers' products
last longer, perform better, and generate less waste. Our high-tech surface solutions and advanced
materials are designed for applications in the most demanding industries.
About us
We make products better with our integrated offering of advanced materials, coating equipment and
services, and component manufacturing. Our global network of highly skilled engineers and problem
solvers is combined with a strong local presence, ensuring we are always close to our customers.


1
Oerlikon at the bottom of the sea

Oerlikon makes metals ready for the deep sea: coatings and materials protect drill bits, valves,
pumps and seals against pressure, corrosion and wear. This increases reliability, lowers costs and
helps protect sensitive underwater environments.

[ Read the full story ][92]
2
Taking off safely and efficiently

From turbines to landing gear, Oerlikon technologies help make aircraft safer, more efficient and
more economical. Our coatings, superalloy components and 3D printed parts protect metal alloys
against extreme heat and loads, supporting the next generation of sustainable aviation.

[ Read the full story ][93]
3
High performance for high performance

Semiconductors power everything from smartphones to cars and AI data centers. Oerlikon supports the
industry with coatings, thermal interface materials and 3D printed components that protect chip
production equipment, improve heat management and help manufacturers push the limits of performance.

[ Read the full story ][94]
4
Sustainable, durable and safe mobility

Oerlikon supports the automotive industry with solutions that make mobility safer and more
sustainable. Our technologies protect battery systems, reduce weight, lower friction and improve
manufacturing efficiency, helping both drivers and manufacturers.

1/4

## Our business model – unique integrated offering

Discover Oerlikon's business model and find out how we make products better. Each part of our
offering has unique strengths, and when combined, these strengths are a true game-changer in terms
of extending product life, saving costs and improving sustainability.
Coating services
From drill bits that stay sharp longer to turbine blades that withstand extreme heat, Oerlikon’s
coating services enhance the performance and durability of critical components across a wide range
of industries.
Coating equipment
From PVD & CVD coaters to thermal spray guns and entire systems, our coating equipment ensures
best-in-class results.
[Metal powder piling up]
Advanced materials
At Oerlikon, we engineer materials that drive innovation. Our portfolio includes ultra-fine metal
and ceramic powders for thermal spray and for 3D printing, as well as high-performance wires – each
designed to withstand pressure, heat, and wear.
Highly specialized components
Oerlikon manufactures precision components that improve product performance, safety, and efficiency
in demanding environments.
Technology toolbox

## Leading know-how in high-tech sectors

Oerlikon has a highly developed technology toolbox that drives our business model. This toolbox
enables our customers to decrease costs, improve their products' performance, and gain a competitive
edge.
[Material science icon - magnifying glass on small particles]
Material Science
Through continuous innovation, we create advanced materials that enhance product performance,
reliability, and efficiency. Our technologies – often refined through powder metallurgy – help our
customers achieve higher durability, energy efficiency, and competitive advantage in their
industries.
[PVD icon - electrons bouncing off a target]
Physical Vapor Deposition
In the PVD process, a high-purity, solid coating material (metals) is either evaporated by heat (arc
evaporation) or by bombardment with ions (sputtering). At the same time, a reactive gas (e.g.,
nitrogen) is added. The gas forms a compound with the metal vapor, which is then deposited on the
tools or components as a thin, highly adherent coating.
[Thermal spray icon - spray from a spray gun]
Thermal Spray
Thermal spraying is a cost-effective method for applying coatings that enhance surface properties.
In the simplest terms, thermal spray involves heating a feedstock material, generally in powder or
wire form, to a molten or semi-molten state. The feedstock is propelled using a stream of gas or
compressed air to deposit it, creating a surface structure on a given substrate.
[Advanced manufacturing icon]
Advanced Manufacturing
Oerlikon manufactures precision components that improve product performance, safety, and efficiency
in demanding environments. Leveraging our expertise in additive metal manufacturing, we produce
lightweight, complex parts that enhance fuel efficiency in aerospace systems.

## 150 years of inventors and pioneers – watch the video to learn more about the 150-year history of
## Oerlikon

1/1

## PVD coatings enhance performance in electrosurgery

Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico’s journey with the Oerlikon **PVD coating BALIMED ARGENTA**.

A trusted partnership between Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico and Oerlikon Balzers delivers Brazil’s
most widely used bipolar forceps – combining antimicrobial protection and surgical precision.

In neurosurgery, where precision and sterility are paramount, the performance of surgical
instruments can directly influence patient outcomes. Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico, one of Brazil’s
leading manufacturers of surgical tools, faced a persistent challenge: tissue adhesion during
coagulation (sealing of small blood vessels) with bipolar forceps. The search for a more effective
and biocompatible solution led to a collaboration with Oerlikon Balzers’ antimicrobial coating:
BALIMED® ARGENTA.

[ Read more ][98]
1/1

## Thermal spray solutions extend range of Mazda MX-30 e-SKYACTIV R-EV

Innovation in the automotive industry has been a driving force for change towards sustainability and
efficiency. The MX-30 e-SKYACTIV R-EV exemplifies Mazda‘s innovative approach to automotive design.

By repurposing the traditional rotary engine (Wankel) as a range extender in a plug-in hybrid
powertrain, Mazda leveraged compactness and lightness to extend the vehicle‘s range significantly.

[ Read the full story ][99]
1/1

## PVD coatings replace PFAS for a safer and better tomorrow

Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), also usually called **“forever chemicals”**, have
attracted significant regulatory attention worldwide due to their indelible nature, potential health
risks, and environmental impact. These synthetic chemicals, used in numerous industrial and consumer
products from non-stick cookware to medical devices, mechanical seals as well as applications where
functional surfaces with non-sticking and low friction properties required.

[ Read more ][100]
