# Global leader in surface technologies & advanced materials

At Oerlikon, we engineer innovative technologies and solutions that make our customers' products
last longer, perform better, and generate less waste. Our high-tech surface solutions and advanced
materials are designed for applications in the most demanding industries.
About us
We make products better with our integrated offering of advanced materials, coating equipment and
services, and component manufacturing. Our global network of highly skilled engineers and problem
solvers is combined with a strong local presence, ensuring we are always close to our customers.


1
Oerlikon at the bottom of the sea

Oerlikon makes metals ready for the deep sea: coatings and materials protect drill bits, valves,
pumps and seals against pressure, corrosion and wear. This increases reliability, lowers costs and
helps protect sensitive underwater environments.

[ Read the full story ][92]
2
Taking off safely and efficiently

From turbines to landing gear, Oerlikon technologies help make aircraft safer, more efficient and
more economical. Our coatings, superalloy components and 3D printed parts protect metal alloys
against extreme heat and loads, supporting the next generation of sustainable aviation.

[ Read the full story ][93]
3
High performance for high performance

Semiconductors power everything from smartphones to cars and AI data centers. Oerlikon supports the
industry with coatings, thermal interface materials and 3D printed components that protect chip
production equipment, improve heat management and help manufacturers push the limits of performance.

[ Read the full story ][94]
4
Sustainable, durable and safe mobility

Oerlikon supports the automotive industry with solutions that make mobility safer and more
sustainable. Our technologies protect battery systems, reduce weight, lower friction and improve
manufacturing efficiency, helping both drivers and manufacturers.

[ Read the full story ][95]
5
Heal better, recover faster

From ultra‑thin coatings on surgical instruments to porous implant surfaces, dental applications and
special 3D printing powders, Oerlikon helps make surgeries safer, implants more durable and recovery
faster. The technologies improve quality of life for millions of patients worldwide.

[ Read the full story ][96]
6
Endless space. Endless possibilities

From the first moon landing to today’s rockets and satellites, Oerlikon technologies perform
critical tasks in space. Our coatings and 3D printed components protect parts against extreme heat,
vacuum and friction and help make missions safer, lighter and more efficient.

[ Read the full story ][97]
1/4

## Our business model – unique integrated offering

Discover Oerlikon's business model and find out how we make products better. Each part of our
offering has unique strengths, and when combined, these strengths are a true game-changer in terms
of extending product life, saving costs and improving sustainability.
Coating services
From drill bits that stay sharp longer to turbine blades that withstand extreme heat, Oerlikon’s
coating services enhance the performance and durability of critical components across a wide range
of industries.
Coating equipment
From PVD & CVD coaters to thermal spray guns and entire systems, our coating equipment ensures
best-in-class results.
[Metal powder piling up]
Advanced materials
At Oerlikon, we engineer materials that drive innovation. Our portfolio includes ultra-fine metal
and ceramic powders for thermal spray and for 3D printing, as well as high-performance wires – each
designed to withstand pressure, heat, and wear.
Highly specialized components
Oerlikon manufactures precision components that improve product performance, safety, and efficiency
in demanding environments.
Technology toolbox

## Leading know-how in high-tech sectors

Oerlikon has a highly developed technology toolbox that drives our business model. This toolbox
enables our customers to decrease costs, improve their products' performance, and gain a competitive
edge.
[Material science icon - magnifying glass on small particles]
Material Science
Through continuous innovation, we create advanced materials that enhance product performance,
reliability, and efficiency. Our technologies – often refined through powder metallurgy – help our
customers achieve higher durability, energy efficiency, and competitive advantage in their
industries.
[PVD icon - electrons bouncing off a target]
Physical Vapor Deposition
In the PVD process, a high-purity, solid coating material (metals) is either evaporated by heat (arc
evaporation) or by bombardment with ions (sputtering). At the same time, a reactive gas (e.g.,
nitrogen) is added. The gas forms a compound with the metal vapor, which is then deposited on the
tools or components as a thin, highly adherent coating.
[Thermal spray icon - spray from a spray gun]
Thermal Spray
Thermal spraying is a cost-effective method for applying coatings that enhance surface properties.
In the simplest terms, thermal spray involves heating a feedstock material, generally in powder or
wire form, to a molten or semi-molten state. The feedstock is propelled using a stream of gas or
compressed air to deposit it, creating a surface structure on a given substrate.
[Advanced manufacturing icon]
Advanced Manufacturing
Oerlikon manufactures precision components that improve product performance, safety, and efficiency
in demanding environments. Leveraging our expertise in additive metal manufacturing, we produce
lightweight, complex parts that enhance fuel efficiency in aerospace systems.

## 150 years of inventors and pioneers – watch the video to learn more about the 150-year history of
## Oerlikon

## PVD coatings enhance performance in electrosurgery

Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico’s journey with the Oerlikon **PVD coating BALIMED ARGENTA**.

A trusted partnership between Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico and Oerlikon Balzers delivers Brazil’s
most widely used bipolar forceps – combining antimicrobial protection and surgical precision.

In neurosurgery, where precision and sterility are paramount, the performance of surgical
instruments can directly influence patient outcomes. Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico, one of Brazil’s
leading manufacturers of surgical tools, faced a persistent challenge: tissue adhesion during
coagulation (sealing of small blood vessels) with bipolar forceps. The search for a more effective
and biocompatible solution led to a collaboration with Oerlikon Balzers’ antimicrobial coating:
BALIMED® ARGENTA.

[ Read more ][98]
1/1

## Thermal spray solutions extend range of Mazda MX-30 e-SKYACTIV R-EV

Innovation in the automotive industry has been a driving force for change towards sustainability and
efficiency. The MX-30 e-SKYACTIV R-EV exemplifies Mazda‘s innovative approach to automotive design.

By repurposing the traditional rotary engine (Wankel) as a range extender in a plug-in hybrid
powertrain, Mazda leveraged compactness and lightness to extend the vehicle‘s range significantly.

[ Read the full story ][99]
1/1

## PVD coatings replace PFAS for a safer and better tomorrow

Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), also usually called **“forever chemicals”**, have
attracted significant regulatory attention worldwide due to their indelible nature, potential health
risks, and environmental impact. These synthetic chemicals, used in numerous industrial and consumer
products from non-stick cookware to medical devices, mechanical seals as well as applications where
functional surfaces with non-sticking and low friction properties required.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Remaker AI?

+

Remaker AI is an AI-powered creative platform with AI image editing as its core feature. It provides
powerful image processing tools that allow users to easily perform photo restoration, background
removal, style transfer, image upscaling, and more. Additionally, Remaker AI includes AI video
generation and a rich library of trending entertainment templates, helping users quickly create
viral short videos, Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts. Whether for individual creators or
enterprise teams, Remaker AI significantly boosts creative efficiency and delivers
professional-grade results.

### How does Remaker AI help improve content creation efficiency?

+

Remaker AI offers a full suite of intelligent tools that can automatically generate and process
images or videos based on simple user inputs. This dramatically saves time while significantly
improving content quality, making it suitable for all industries and creative scenarios.

### Do I need technical knowledge to use Remaker AI?

+

No technical knowledge is required. Remaker AI features a clean and intuitive interface that anyone
can pick up instantly. Every tool page also includes detailed step-by-step tutorials to help users
get started quickly.

### Does Remaker AI support multilingual content generation?

+

Yes. Remaker AI supports content generation in multiple languages including English, Chinese,
Japanese, German, and many others, allowing users worldwide to create high-quality assets in their
preferred language.

### How much does Remaker AI cost?

+

Remaker AI offers flexible credit-based plans ranging from $5.99 for 200 credits to $299 for 20,000
credits. Users can choose the package that best fits their needs. Many basic features are also
available for free.

### Does Remaker AI offer free credits or a free trial?

+

Yes. New users receive free credits upon sign-up, which can be used to generate and export
watermark-free images and videos. Additional credits and advanced features can be unlocked by
upgrading to VIP.

### Can I cancel my Remaker AI subscription at any time?

+

Remaker AI uses a one-time credit purchase model with no recurring monthly fees, so there is no
subscription to cancel.

### Can I use Remaker AI on both PC and mobile devices?

+

Yes. Remaker AI works seamlessly on Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android devices. Log in with the same
account and edit or enhance your photos and videos anytime, anywhere.

### Is payment on Remaker AI secure?

+

Yes. All payments are securely processed by Stripe. Remaker AI does not store your card information.
Stripe uses bank-level encryption and security standards to keep your payment information safe.

## Conference Collaborations

[View all ][87]

##### [Immune Aging Conference][88]

Aging is a complex and multi-dimensional process that affects all tissues of all organisms.
Accumulating evidence suggests that disruption of immune homeostasis and responses with age plays a
significant role in the aetiology and pathogenesis of many aging-associated diseases. Recent
advances in genomic technologies (e.g., single cell, spatial approaches), combined with advances in
molecular techniques (CRISPR-Cas9), enable precise descriptions of molecular and cellular changes
associated with immune system aging in human cells as well as in model organisms. With these
advances, we are in need of interdisciplinary settings to promote interactions to foster
collaborative research and career advancement across disciplines.

##### [Second International Conference on Digital Intelligence for Energy Systems (ICDIES 2026)][89]

The Second International Conference on Digital Intelligence for Energy Systems (ICDIES 2026) will
bring together researchers, industry professionals, and policymakers to discuss the latest
developments in digital technologies for energy systems. The conference focuses on the application
of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Big Data, Internet of Things (IoT), digital twins, and advanced
analytics to improve energy efficiency, renewable energy integration, smart grid operation, and
sustainable energy management. ICDIES 2026 provides an international platform for knowledge
exchange, interdisciplinary collaboration, and the promotion of innovative solutions for the future
of intelligent and low-carbon energy systems.

##### [4th Metabolism in Health & Disease Conference][90]

Metabolism is central to most biological processes that impact health and disease, from subcellular
organelles to whole-body homeostasis. Correct metabolic rewiring drives development and maintenance
of tissues, whereas metabolic dysfunction is a factor in key issues that affect worldwide
populations such as aging, cancer and metabolic diseases. Despite the huge advances in metabolism
research, key questions need answering to translate our knowledge into impactful solutions.

## Conference Collaborations

[View all ][87]

##### [Immune Aging Conference][88]

Aging is a complex and multi-dimensional process that affects all tissues of all organisms.
Accumulating evidence suggests that disruption of immune homeostasis and responses with age plays a
significant role in the aetiology and pathogenesis of many aging-associated diseases. Recent
advances in genomic technologies (e.g., single cell, spatial approaches), combined with advances in
molecular techniques (CRISPR-Cas9), enable precise descriptions of molecular and cellular changes
associated with immune system aging in human cells as well as in model organisms. With these
advances, we are in need of interdisciplinary settings to promote interactions to foster
collaborative research and career advancement across disciplines.

##### [Second International Conference on Digital Intelligence for Energy Systems (ICDIES 2026)][89]

The Second International Conference on Digital Intelligence for Energy Systems (ICDIES 2026) will
bring together researchers, industry professionals, and policymakers to discuss the latest
developments in digital technologies for energy systems. The conference focuses on the application
of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Big Data, Internet of Things (IoT), digital twins, and advanced
analytics to improve energy efficiency, renewable energy integration, smart grid operation, and
sustainable energy management. ICDIES 2026 provides an international platform for knowledge
exchange, interdisciplinary collaboration, and the promotion of innovative solutions for the future
of intelligent and low-carbon energy systems.

##### [4th Metabolism in Health & Disease Conference][90]

Metabolism is central to most biological processes that impact health and disease, from subcellular
organelles to whole-body homeostasis. Correct metabolic rewiring drives development and maintenance
of tissues, whereas metabolic dysfunction is a factor in key issues that affect worldwide
populations such as aging, cancer and metabolic diseases. Despite the huge advances in metabolism
research, key questions need answering to translate our knowledge into impactful solutions.

# We areSmart Materials

We are a team of researchers at the University of Manchester dedicated to advancing the field of
smart materials for cutting-edge anticounterfeiting solutions. Our work focuses on the development
of innovative, colour-changing luminescent smart materials designed for rapid and reliable
authentication processes. These materials hold transformative potential in combating counterfeit
goods by offering visually dynamic, easily verifiable authentication features.

## Our SolutionColour-changing LuminescentSmart Materials

Smart Materials offers a groundbreaking solution to the global challenge of counterfeiting with its
innovative color-changing luminescent technology. Unlike traditional static luminescent materials
that are prone to replication, our smart materials exhibit an unprecedented dynamic luminescent
color change when exposed to UV light, providing a highly secure and visually distinctive
authentication feature.

This advanced technology is designed to deliver rapid and reliable authentication, setting a new
standard in the anticounterfeit market. Our materials can be seamlessly integrated into a wide range
of applications, including currency, secure documents, product packaging, and luxury goods, ensuring
unmatched protection against fraud and counterfeit threats.

By combining cutting-edge material science with practical deployment capabilities, Smart Materials
introduces a revolutionary, scalable, and effective solution for safeguarding authenticity,
enhancing trust, and protecting economic stability in an increasingly counterfeit-prone world.

[Contact Us][6]

## Clients

## Our TargetMarkets

## Security Technology

Our materials offer robust solutions for counterfeit detection, secure tracking, and identity
verification.

## Ink & Printing Companies

By integrating our products with modern authentication systems, ink companies can provide scalable,
cost-effective solutions that enhance protection against forgery.

## Pharmaceuticals

Through the use of innovative technologies such as Smart Materials, tamper-evident packaging can
ensure product authenticity and patient safety.

## Luxury Goods

By embedding color-changing luminescent smart materials into watch designs, seamless and elegant
authentication can be vastly improved.

# Security System Design

#### Cut design time in half for faster, accurate designs that win.

#### Manage the lifecycle of systems & multiply productivity.

[ Try it free ][63]
[ Learn More ][64]

**System Surveyor**

## AI NotetakerBeta

#### Turn site walk conversations into accurate & actionable project documentation

#### Your on-site companion for site walks that captures the discussion, automates a Statement of
#### Work, and preserves a trusted record of customer requirements.

[ Learn More ][65]

**System Surveyor**

## Phone app

#### Take System Surveyor with you for Installs

#### Now, everything you need in the hands of your installers, technicians and subcontractors for
#### more accurate, timely installs and lifecycle maintenance. No more print-outs, one single source
#### of truth.

[ Learn More ][66]

**System Surveyor**

## Camera Advisor™

#### Visualize & select the right camera every time

#### Using DORI standards, show the resolution and pixels per foot with images for easy camera
#### selection

[ Learn More ][67]

## Benefits for Everyone in the Security System Design Ecosystem

#### System Surveyor: A true win-win-win

[[system integrators]][68]

#### [System Integrators][69]

Drive sales and better customer engagement with an accurate, decision-ready design. Win more with
faster, more professional designs & proposals. **[Learn more][70].**

#### [Technology Directors][71]

Take control of life-cycle management with a digital as-built. Visualize with stakeholders and
collaborate with partners and subcontractors. **[Learn more.][72]**

#### [Manufacturers][73]

Easy, intelligent design for your products at the first site survey. Enable partners to automate a
bill of materials for your brand. **[Learn more.][74]**

#### Trusted By

## Easy, Mobile Drag & Drop Design

Use the native tablet app for a site walk in the field. Upload a floor plan or access Google Maps.
Show device placements & area of coverage. Work offline & sync later.

[**Learn More**][75]

[ipad-border]

## Perfect for Remote Collaboration

Engage everyone in the project in one place. Share projects and designs with your team,
subcontractors, engineers and customers in real time.

[**Learn More**][76]

## Product Benefits

### Simplify site surveys, collaborate on security system design and automate a BOM.

Gather Requirements
Design Clean Up
Share and Collaborate
Create Reports and Proposals
Accelerate Installs
Gather Requirements

process. Get the site walk right and the rest is easier. Drag-and-drop predefined element icons,
take photos and capture key details.  Photos will automatically be associated to the floor plan and
security devices. The old way took hours and led to mistakes – you’re already way ahead of the game!

1. **Mobile tablet app** to take into the field for site surveys.
2. **Easily import floor plans** or create a floor plan, set the scale and start designing.

when you get the basics right first time, the benefits last for decades: delivering warmer, more
comfortable homes and buildings, lower energy bills, and a stronger, more energy-efficient UK

_________________________________________________________________________________________________
HOW DO ELECTRIC BOILERS DIFFER FROM GAS ONES? The short answer to this is that they use different
methods of heating water. A gas boiler takes in gas from the national network supply and burns it to
produce heat. This then goes through a heat exchanger, which heats the water used for both your
central heating and hot water. With an electric boiler, it’s a similar process but instead of
burning natural gas to create heat, an electric boiler heats the water using power directly from an
electricity source (almost always the national grid). It works a lot like a kettle. This means that
electric boilers are actually significantly more efficient than their gas counterparts. Modern gas
boilers can reach as high as 95% efficiency (or even higher), but electric boilers can reach 100%

central heating and hot water. With an electric boiler, it’s a similar process but instead of
burning natural gas to create heat, an electric boiler heats the water using power directly from an

electric boilers are actually significantly more efficient than their gas counterparts. Modern gas
boilers can reach as high as 95% efficiency (or even higher), but electric boilers can reach 100%
efficiency. However there are a lot of issues with electric boilers that don’t come up with gas
boilers. In this podcast, we explain the benefits and drawback or electric boilers, and discuss the
